_note: Field keys captured on the 2026-07-13 calibration run (provider view, case CA-VOWXT6JN). Radio/checkbox names are Form.io input name prefixes — match with input[name*=...]. Suffixes in [] change per render; never hardcode them.

medical_history.note: vitals are optional when both 'I have checked this section' checkboxes are ticked

general_health_radios._warning: option values use EN-DASH (–) not hyphen — match with includes('1–2') or normalize dashes

functional_status_safety.attestation_radio: functional_safety_adls_radio_statement (pick the 'adequate support / no difficulty' value)
functional_status_safety.other_radios: falls/afraid/assistive devices (None/...)/housing (Home)/utilities/grab bars/safe at home/abuse/drive/seatbelt/drinking/transportation — mostly Yes/No/N/A; default No is safe EXCEPT seatbelt-type positives (generic No fallback worked)

orders.flow: Assessment & Plan → Manage Orders button → 'Available Services' modal → Order per service → form → Save Order → back to list. Ordered services lose their Order button.
orders.genetic_forms: Lab pre-filled; 'Test Panel' = .formio-component-select with LAZY options — TRUSTED click required (JS click does nothing), wait ≤15s for options, pick a NON-'CUSTOM PANEL' option; selecting a panel auto-ticks Test Parameters; then tick the first Reason checkbox; deeper selects like 'Indications for Testing' may appear — same trusted pattern.
orders.cgm_bgm: starts with 'Patient Consent: CGM/BGM' (3 checkboxes 'Patient agrees with the statement above' + 'Confirm Consent & Continue'); then form needs Supplier/Device Preference (Choices), 'Year diagnosed with Diabetes' (text), 'Is patient currently taking Insulin?' + several more radios (default No/first ok).
orders.cgx_gotcha: picking a Breast-related personal-cancer option spawns 'Specify Breast Cancer laterality' (required) — pick a NON-breast option or fill laterality.

call_flow.ORDER (user-confirmed): 1) Call Mobile -> patient answers FIRST; 2) the MOMENT it connects, ring provider (row Call button -> dropdown -> VOICE) - zero pause; 3) switch to provider tab and ANSWER the pop immediately (green fa-phone button) - answering assigns the Pending case; 4) poll the CA-link every 5s (<=45s) until the case opens (fallback: cid URL + reload, only AFTER answering)
call_flow.pss_phone_button: case-header button with i.fa-phone -> full-screen call overlay
call_flow.call_mobile: DOCUMENTED PATH (user 2026-08-07): click the CARET to the right of 'Call Mobile' -> menu 'Call Mobile' / 'Call Landline' (disabled) / 'Open Dialer' -> click 'Call Mobile'. Direct click on the big button also works (prov-01b tries caret first, falls back). States: ringing = '+1 804 222 1111' + 'Calling...'; connected = timer 'MM:SS/ 20 mins' + waveform + 'Switch to Digital' + bottom-left 'Patient: +1 804 222 1111'. 'Call Mobile' DISAPPEARS once ringing - never re-click blindly; testcall may be busy -> one 15s backoff retry
call_flow.ring_provider: CLICK the DR VU Doctor row on the NAME area (~35% of row width, never the leading checkbox) -> the row highlights and a 'Call' button appears on its right (button.rf-btn-call-single, or a leaf element with exact text 'Call') -> click it -> menu 'Voice' / 'Video' -> click 'Voice'. HOVER ALONE IS NOT ENOUGH - the row must be CLICKED (user-corrected 2026-08-07). The blue 'Ring selected Providers' button is NOT this path: pressing it with no provider ticked only pops the dialog 'Please select provider to call list' with a 'Got it' button.
call_flow.provider_pop: Pop content: 'PSTN Call' / 'PSS, PATIENT' / '<Patient>,VU PSS' / 'Patient ID: PT-...' / 'Case ID: CA-...' / Service / Reason of Visit / 'your data will be lost in order to process video call'. Arrives via WEBSOCKET (works in Playwright) if the provider page stayed stable. Poll <=30s for /PSTN Call|PSS, PATIENT/. EXACT BUTTONS (captured 2026-08-07): ANSWER = button.btn.btn-success.btn-lg > i.spicon-call-up (green rgb(40,167,69), 56x56); DECLINE = button.btn.btn-danger.btn-lg > i.spicon-icon-call-off (red rgb(220,53,69)). The buttons live OUTSIDE the div that contains the 'PSTN Call' text - do NOT scope the search to that node (the old detector returned answeredVia=null for exactly this reason). ANSWER FIRST, INSPECT LATER: the pop self-dismisses in ~20-30s; running DOM analysis before clicking loses it.
call_flow.assignment: answering the pop assigns the case; URL cid navigation alone only works for already-assigned cases
call_flow.provider_case_open: CA-link in mini call widget (leaf element with exact case id text); fallback #/?cid=<cid> + reload
call_flow.overlay_layout_2026_08_07: LEFT: patient card (name, address, (804) 222-1111, DNA Insights) + [Call Mobile |caret] + [Send Invite |caret]. RIGHT: 'No dedicated providers with matching states' / 'MATCHING STATES: (1 provider)' / gear / [Ring selected Providers |caret] / 'Select all' / row: [checkbox][avatar] 'DR VU Doctor' + '8 States' ...... hover-revealed 'Call' | presence badge. Bottom bar: Reschedule / Open Case / Call History / Mic / Camera / [Leave call]
call_flow.presence_CORRECTED_2026_08_07: The 'Offline' badge DOES NOT block the call: the hover-revealed Call button is present and ringing an Offline DR VU Doctor still delivers the pop (user screenshots 2026-08-07). prov-01a no longer gates on Online - it waits only for the ROW to exist and records providerPresence for information. The old 90s Online poll is what caused the 2026-07-15 'BLOCKED at ring-provider' abort. Still true: any goto/reload on the provider page kills the pop websocket -> retry 01b ONLY, never 01a+01b.
call_flow.got_it_dialog: 'Please select provider to call list' + [Got it] = the provider row was never selected. Click Got it, then click the ROW and use its Call button. Do not retry Ring selected Providers.
